components.html:
Dynamics 365 F&O

Posting rule: an unapproved invoice must not post.

narrative.overview: Four metal sections illustrate an invoice approval requirement translated into a posting rule, tested before and after approval, then gated for release. Shared guide rails express that dependency; they do not model Dynamics architecture.

rules.name: The Continuity Rule
rules.body: Red marks connection or action, never an invented success metric.

dos: Do keep the illustrative disclosure visible and independent of interaction.
Do preserve readable HTML content outside the canvas.
donts: Don't invent case studies, results, availability, contact channels, or sending behavior.
Don't use the mechanical analogy as a claim about real Dynamics architecture.

handoff.rule: An unapproved invoice must not post.
handoff.release: Both cases must pass before release.
handoff.changeDependency: A changed rule needs new tests before release.
handoff.limitation: Illustrative explanation only. The control moves geometry, not invoices or real releases.
